barRaise.topFinding: Version lockstep came back and the game got measurably worse at the same time, from the same commit. v0.99.41 flipped DEBUG_INFINITE_RESOURCES from const true to a runtime flag defaulting off, so the real cost and cap economy is live for the first time since v0.32.x, and the caps it turned on do not fit the game: RESOURCE_BASE_CAP holds biomass, aggregate, alloy and volatiles at 50 while 11 of 37 catalog buildings and 4 of 5 research techs price above that, and economy.register_warehouse (the only cap-raising path) has zero callers, so Extractor, Refinery, Marksman and Breacher are now unreachable in every run and the exported 400/300/200/120 start values silently clamp to 50. The same flip changed what a saved res block means without bumping SAVE_VERSION, so any pre-2026-07-24 save loaded through the lit Continue button clamps 10000 down to 50 with no warning and no migration branch. Underneath that, this pass also caught the review apparatus lying about itself: today's audit-hordes-nightly died on an API 500 fifty-seven seconds after spawn and wrote nothing, yet lastRunAt was stamped clean, and the 2026-07-29 bar-raise was dropped inside a 9h40m window where the scheduler stayed alive declining every slot with global_limit after a MemoryExhaustion crash saturated the concurrency budget. Health lands at 66, down 5, with playability at 42 and skill-suite-health, work-queue-hygiene and skill-chain-handoff-integrity all under 55.
